title: FNAF Opening Camera
blurb: Up goes the monitor, and with it a burst of grainy static and a mechanical clunk you will hear several hundred times a night. Flipping cameras in Five Nights at Freddy's is compulsive and dangerous in equal measure, since the tablet blocks your view of the office and the clock keeps running while you check. The tablet is a liability. The sound became load-bearing for the series' entire rhythm — check, panic, drop the monitor, check again. Edit creators use it as a scene transition, usually right before something appears that was not there before.
origin: The camera monitor sound from Five Nights at Freddy's.
